_about: How grade.py turns findings into the overall tier. Data, not code: change these values through the Learn step (record_feedback.py logs why). The tier is the highest level whose rule is met. Manipulation (hidden prompts) and paraphraser evidence are reported separately: they are serious, but they are not evidence that an AI wrote the text.

conclusive._note: A confirmed artefact (scan_artifacts.py, then confirmed in context in judgements.json) from one of these categories.

strong._note: Two or more fabricated references; a strong close-reading finding (if reading_strong_ok); a confirmed hit in strong_categories; or the web rule below.

moderate._note: The style score counts as moderate evidence only if its validated AUROC (calibration.json) reaches min_style_auroc; otherwise it is weak context at most. One fabricated reference, two close-reading findings, a model-phrasing hit, or a shift from the author's own baseline also count.

weak._note: Context only: style past its 5% threshold in a share of windows, any single reading observation, any weak marker.

web._note: A web tool flags the document when chunks holding at least flag_share of the words score >= 0.5. Two validated tools flagging, plus one non-statistical line (artefacts, references, reading, baseline), make it strong. A tool counts only if its scanned chunks cover at least min_coverage of the text.

combined._note: Calibrated combination of web detectors across splits (evidence.py). Moderate needs the document to be at least moderate_times more likely under AI, with at least min_good_tools tools that reached good_auroc on known texts among those counted. At most counter_times is reported as counter-evidence. Never strong on its own. passage_times: a single passage at or above this (stricter than the document bar, since several passages are tested) also gives moderate, worded as localised evidence. A tool is counted at all only with at least min_known_texts human and min_known_texts AI known texts and an AUROC of at least min_auroc (evidence.py, web_controls.py).

separate._note: Reported apart from the tier: serious, but not evidence that an AI wrote the text.

caveats._note: Below short_text_words, the report warns that the statistics are unreliable.
